extraction.notes: Three-month 2022 column only. AIR reports no AFFO metric; its adjusted FFO is 'Pro forma FFO', so core_total is Pro forma FFO and affo fields are null. Shares reported in full (154,057 thousand of shares printed as 154,057 in the table, unit consistent with the thousands totals; reproduces $0.53 NAREIT FFO and $0.58 pro forma FFO). Zero-valued lines ('—' printed) are included with amount 0: gain on dispositions, loss on extinguishment of debt. The 'Separation, business transformation, and transition related costs' line was mapped to severance_restructuring as the closest fit (footnote describes consulting, placement, legal and transformation costs). 'Incremental cash received from leased properties' and the participating securities/tax lines were mapped to 'other'. Recurring capex not set because the company has no AFFO section; for reference, Supplemental Schedule 9 (page 33 printed page per TOC, seq 35) shows Capital Replacements of $7,885 thousand for the three months ended Sept 30, 2022 (consolidated, not adjusted for NCI). Page numbers printed on this schedule are blank in the markers.
